name: fpga-support
description: all in one vscode plugin for Verilog/VHDL development

digital-ide.function.lsp.systemverilog.e.description: Expands SystemVerilog include files during parsing and diagnostics.

digital-ide.function.simulate.vendorCach.description: Shared vendor simulation-library cache root. The backend separates entries by vendor, tool version, simulator, and device family.

digital-ide.function.lsp.diagnostics.ove.description: Disables Digital-IDE diagnostics by diagnostic code.

digital-ide.function.lsp.semantic.tokens.description: Semantically distinguishes scalar clock and reset ports in Verilog and SystemVerilog.
Adds read and write semantic modifiers from Verilog and SystemVerilog port directions.

digital-ide.function.lsp.inlayHints.port.description: Shows port names and directions for Verilog and SystemVerilog module connections.

digital-ide.function.lsp.inlayHints.para.description: Shows parameter names for ordered Verilog and SystemVerilog module parameter assignments.

digital-ide.debugger.waveformUrl.description: Wave Server WebSocket endpoint used for direct hardware capture delivery.

digital-ide.debugger.vivado.hwServerUrl.description: Optional exact Vivado Hardware Server URL.

digital-ide.debugger.vivado.target.description: Optional exact Vivado hardware target name.

digital-ide.debugger.vivado.programBefor.description: Program the hash-verified bitstream before each Hardware Manager request.

digital-ide.debugger.vivado.timeoutMs.description: Maximum duration of one Vivado Hardware Manager request in milliseconds.

editor/title.when: editorLangId == verilog || editorLangId == systemverilog || editorLangId == vhdl

editor/context.when: editorLangId == verilog || editorLangId == systemverilog || editorLangId == vhdl

explorer/context.when: resourceLangId == verilog || resourceLangId == systemverilog || resourceLangId == vhdl
resourceLangId == verilog || resourceLangId == systemverilog || resourceLangId == vhdl
resourceLangId == verilog || resourceLangId == systemverilog || resourceLangId == vhdl

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:waveform && npm run build:netlist && npm run compile -- --outDir out-js && node ./node_modules/webpack/bin/webpack.js --mode production
scripts.test:lsp-desktop: npm run compile && npm run build:server && node ./out/test/runTest.js --grep "SystemVerilog desktop LSP|VHDL desktop LSP"
scripts.test:webui: npm run build:waveform && npm run build:netlist && npm run compile && npm run build:server && node ./out/test/runTest.js --grep "Webview integration"
scripts.test:netlist-webui: npm run check:netlist-fixtures && npm run build:netlist && npm run compile && npm run build:server && node ./out/test/runTest.js --grep "Netlist Webview integration"
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build:waveform && npm run build:netlist && npm run compile && npm run lint && npm run build:server && node ./out/test/runTest.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test:webui && npm run test:protocol && npm run test:server && npm run test:desktop
